title: Simple Machines
summary: Levers, pulleys and inclined planes: mechanical advantage, velocity ratio and efficiency.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 7: Work, Energy and Simple Machines

objectives: I can explain how levers, pulleys and ramps make work easier.
I can calculate mechanical advantage and efficiency.
I can explain why no machine reduces the work done.
misconceptions: Machines reduce the amount of work you have to do.
A machine can be more than 100% efficient.
A single fixed pulley reduces the effort needed.
